title: Chelate Shell skill manifest
description: Metadata contract for skills/<skill>/manifest.json. Every skill lives at exactly one level under skills/ — no namespace folders, because the host skill scanners do not descend into them. All logical hierarchy lives in these fields (notably `stage`).

name.description: Unique skill id; must equal the directory name under skills/.

version.description: Semantic version of the skill, e.g. 1.2.0.

stage.description: Pipeline stage: workspace (legacy infrastructure), ingest (extraction), gates (quality gates), processors (post-processing), infrastructure (v1.3.0 security/plumbing), generation (v1.3.0 multimodal output), domain_extensions (v1.3.0 3D etc.).

input_types.description: Input kinds this skill accepts, e.g. ["pdf", "latex_string", "csv"]. The router matches user inputs against this list.

output_type.description: Primary output kind, e.g. gate_result, json, markdown.

output_types.description: Full set of output kinds this skill can emit; output_type is the primary member. Used by the router for multi-output routing.

dependencies.description: Third-party import names required at runtime; missing ones degrade the skill to UNVERIFIED.

sandbox_required.description: True when the skill must run inside an isolated environment (heavy or unsafe dependencies). core/sandbox.py resolves this.

entrypoint.description: Adapter script relative to the skill root; must be run.py in v1.1.0.

description.description: One-line human/AI-readable summary of the skill.
